verdict.rationale: LlamaParse is a document-parsing API platform, not an agent or tool-orchestrating client, so consuming external MCP servers' tools does not fit its product role. The pack's MCP evidence is server-side only: the platform exposes Parse/Extract/Classify/Split/Index and doc-search tools to MCP clients. That server capability does not make the client axis applicable, and nothing shows LlamaParse itself connecting to MCP servers.
